items.html: And behold, with this that we explained will be reconciled the two verses: one says "and God created [va-Yivra] the man," and the other says "and the Lord God formed [va-Yitzer] the man." For the truth is that the body of man was formed from Yetzirah, and this is what "and He formed" says. And after Beriah descended and clothed in Yetzirah, it is found that it is as if he was created from Beriah, and this is what "and He created" says.
